data.long_meaning: Mulhama is an Arabic name for a woman, meaning 'Mother of the flood'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'mulhama' which means 'flood'. This name is often given to a baby girl born during a heavy rain or flood season. Mulhama is a beautiful and unique name that evokes a sense of strength and resilience. The name Mulhama carries the meaning “Mother of the flood” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mulhama usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of the flood and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It symbolizes the transformative power of nature and the strength and resilience of those who weather the storms of life. Mulhama is a name that inspires us to be strong and resilient in the face of adversity and to find peace and solace in the power of nature.
